title: Now — who to ring
blurb: Flow (a). The app opens on one person. Piles filter the same list; swipe for Later today / Not mine.

title: The call moment — outcome + next step
blurb: Flow (b). Before the call, the dialer, coming back, one tap, saved with Undo, next person. Includes a cold-restart and the 360×640 fit.

title: Every outcome, what it does
blurb: Flow (b) table. Not received (retry), wrong number, call back later, interested → visit, not interested → reason, connected → requirement.

title: Lead list — status from the row
blurb: Flow (b′). Tap the chip, pick, the sheet grows one row when the status needs a time or a reason, row stays put, Undo.

title: Lead record
blurb: The full page: requirement, next step, homes sent, timeline with Edit on your own rows.

title: Site visit — book, the day of, how it went
blurb: Flow (d). Visit card on Now, camera + GPS, outcome chips, no-show reschedule, location refused.

title: Send homes on WhatsApp
blurb: Flow (e). Shortlist and matches, Send, the ack with a next step offered, the buyer's tap coming back as Came back.

title: Calling — the owner list
blurb: Flow (f). Same queue shape; project · unit · locality on every row; owner outcome sheet; Interested → Add their flat.

title: New lead — push, first call, walk-in
blurb: Flows (c) and (g). The push, the First call card, a repeat enquiry, Add lead with a duplicate found.

title: Someone calls back — search

blurb: Section 11 of flows.md, as the agent reads it under Me. Also the Undo and no-outcome recovery states.
